acceptance_dimensions.silhouette_exterior_identity: Atlas orange control bands and a cyan/black integration crown identify a cross-vendor industrial controls campus rather than a passive records archive
acceptance_dimensions.interior_zoning_circulation: intake, prototype control cells, operator gallery, secure controller core, vendor-retrofit bay and archive route are separately readable
